text:
ivy: Heads-up: vendor OpsSec scheduled a full whitebox against staging + infra next Wed. Need to lock RBAC, KMS access pattern, evidence pipeline, and retest booking. Looping @omar and @nisha.
omar: Quick constraints: staging-only, ephemeral SSO roles, explicit vendor IP allowlist, no CI pipeline tokens.
kevin: Proposal: create `pt-external-{eng-id}` session role with a session policy scoping to `arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/staging-*` and conditions: aws:SourceIp + aws:TokenIssueTime limit. We'll also attach a key policy allowing Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey with GrantTokens blocked.
nisha: Audit asks: enable CloudTrail management + S3 data events for exact evidence prefix. Stream events to Chronicle (our SIEM) + tag with pt_id. Keep retention 13 months.
ivy: Evidence ingest: vendor will PUT to presigned URLs. Requirements: x-amz-meta-sha256, content-type set, filename pattern `pt/{id}/reports/{type}/{file}`. No anonymous multipart uploads.
kevin: Minimal KMS policy snippet we can share with vendor for review:
```
"Statement": [{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/pt-2026-key"
}]
```
omar: Additional controls: presign service should enforce max size 250MB, single-part only, and require a sha256 header. After upload, an async validator lambda will verify checksum and move object to `locked/` prefix with ObjectLock GOVERNANCE:21d.
evidence-bot: [INFO] Presign requests must include `{\"pt_id\":\"<id>\"}` in metadata for traceability. Logs emitted to `cloudwatch:/pt-presign` with structured JSON.
nisha: For remediations: vendor can open tickets via our webhook or email-inserted CSV (we prefer webhook). Intake flow: vendor POST -> create vuln-tracker card in `PT Intake` board -> assign to oncall triage. SLA: ack 12h, triage note 48h, remediation ETA: 3 business days for crits.
ivy: Retest coordination: vendor requests a retest window after fixes. We offer 2 candidate slots (overnight preferred): 00:30-02:30 PT or 03:00-05:00 PT. Oncall to confirm staffing. Post-retest we do immediate KMS key rotation for any keys used and revoke ephemeral role sessions.
oncall: [BOT] PD stub created PD-PT-2026-77. I will cover the first slot.
kevin: Action items: 1) create role + session policy + KMS key ACL (owner: kevin, due: EOD). 2) export session policy JSON for vendor review.
omar: Action: implement presign service constraints + upload validator + ObjectLock move (owner: omar, due: EOD).
nisha: Action: enable CloudTrail data events + SIEM forward + set log retention (owner: nisha, due: EOD).
ivy: I'll send the vendor onboarding email with the S3 prefix and checklist, and update vulnerability board with a `PT: incoming` column (sending now).
kevin: Sharing the key policy draft in thread shortly.
nisha: Tiny ask: please include a note about HSM-backed keys required for regulated engagements; flag if vendor needs HSM decrypt.
ivy: Noted. We'll flag HSM requirement in the handshake.
oncall: ack
kevin: ack
omar: ack
ivy: Closing thread for now. Reopen if vendor asks different key actions or if ops needs more time. Thanks everyone!
